name: ATM Property Component 1
definition: Set of properties to update on a terminal.

PropertyName.name: Property Name
PropertyName.definition: The name of the property to be update on the terminal.

PropertyType.name: Property Type
PropertyType.definition: The type of the property. It will be one of: String, Number, Boolean, JSON, CSV (i.e. a CSV1 string representing a table of data).

PropertyValue.name: Property Value
PropertyValue.definition: The value to be assigned to the property.
